short: The one HTTP stack every mount serves through
is: The leaf crate holding the stack the HTTP server runs: the detach layer that runs each request's handling to its end in its own tracked task (bounded by a request semaphore, a panic answered with the internal-error problem), the session layer inside it, the request log around both, and the server with its graceful shutdown; main, the dev profile and the test-support rigs all serve through it.
conventions: Only `stack` builds a `Stacked`, and `serve` serves nothing else; `axum::serve` is banned in api and test-support by their clippy.toml, so no mount skips the detach layer.
The detach layer wraps the session layer, so the session save after a handler runs to its end with it.
A permit is taken before the spawn; a request waits for one rather than answering 503. No timeout runs inside a detached task.
The panic answer equals the API's internal-error problem; api/src/problem/tests.rs pins the two together.

A request body idle for BODY_IDLE_TIMEOUT between frames (tower-http's per-frame RequestBodyTimeout) fails its read inside the handler, so a stalled body frees its permit; a steady upload is never cut.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: crate manifest: axum, tokio, tokio-util (rt: TaskTracker), tower-layer/tower-service, tower-http (timeout, trace), tracing, serde_json, thiserror, http-cookies, tower-sessions; tracing-subscriber for tests

fs.name: src/detach.rs
fs.role: Detach: the layer running each request in a tracked task under a semaphore permit; drain waits for them until a deadline; panic_answer is the 500 problem a panicked request answers

fs.name: src/detach/tests.rs
fs.role: pins a dropped request running to its end, the permit bound (the next request waits, no task spawned) and the panic answer

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: façade: re-exports Detach, Detached, REQUEST_PERMITS, Unfinished, panic_answer, RequestLog, UNMATCHED_ROUTE, request_log, and BODY_IDLE_TIMEOUT, SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE, Stacked, serve, stack

fs.name: src/request_log.rs
fs.role: request_log: tower-http TraceLayer whose debug span request{id, method, route} carries the MatchedPath template or "(unmatched)", never the URI or a header; debug events request started / request finished (status, latency_ms); id = <pid>-<counter>; no response header

fs.name: src/request_log/tests.rs
fs.role: pins the route template, method, status and latency on the lines, no URI/query/cookie/authorization value, the fixed unmatched route, the detached handling inside the request span, and distinct <pid>-<n> ids carried by no response header

fs.name: src/served.rs
fs.role: stack (the app under the session layer and the body idle timeout, inside Detach, with the request log outermost), Stacked (outer layers only outside), serve (graceful shutdown, then the drain, within SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE of the signal)

fs.name: src/served/tests.rs
fs.role: pins a cut request still saving its session (the session layer inside Detach), shutdown holding while a detached request runs, and a stalled body failing its read and freeing its permit
